title: Lotus Sorceress
description: A beautiful female sorceress with long flowing black hair and ornate purple headdress floats gracefully above a misty pond. She wears a revealing pink and red traditional dress with long flowing ribbons, holding a glowing magical staff with a green crystalline head that hovers beside her.
prompt: A graceful female sorceress with long flowing black hair and an elaborate purple headdress floats dynamically above a misty lotus pond at dusk. She wears a revealing pink and red oriental dress with long flowing ribbons and sashes trailing in the air. A magical staff with a glowing green crystal head hovers beside her, emitting light and energy. The atmosphere is ethereal with soft blue mist, lily pads on dark water, and dramatic lighting.
